entry.intro: Bring a torch, a needle sword and a little courage. Stories await within the stump.
entry.setup: First setup · Create a separate game save
entry.login: Connected · Sign in to your account
entry.accounts: Creates kp, player1 and player2 test accounts sharing this initial password.
entry.sessions: Separate login pages support different accounts. Copies of the same page URL share its session.
lobby.intro: Explore ten locations in Stumpsville. Preset actions resolve automatically; request Keeper rulings for other events.
lobby.ready: After character approval, check your inventory and mark yourself ready.
create.explanation: Presets are custom characters. Random creation: each attribute takes the highest two of 3d6; HP and pips use d6 each.
create.name: Mouse name
create.starting: Starting presets include a needle sword, torch, rations and rope.
create.background: For random characters, the Keeper checks HP and pips against the background table and confirms two background items and low-attribute compensation. Equipment remains a draft until approved.
create.help: Submit for the Keeper to approve attributes, background equipment and ownership.
ready.wait: Submit a character and wait for approval.
ready.check: Your character and inventory are approved. Review them and mark yourself ready.
recap.empty: The Keeper has not published a recap yet.
recap.wait: Waiting for the Keeper to resume exploration
share.title: Share a receipt summary
share.help: The original receipt generates a text summary. Private character data is not included.
spell.text: Cast {name}; please adjudicate power, usage and effects.
transfer.text: Request to transfer the item in slot {count}
rules.title: Rules reference
scene.nocharacter: Create a character and wait for approval.
scene.rulesmissing: Scene rules are not installed. Wait for the Keeper.
scene.executoroffline: The Keeper executor is offline. Actions will queue for resolution.
chat.nochannels: No conversations. Choose New private chat to select a contact.
dialog.travelhelp: Published, adjacent, open routes resolve automatically. Explicit requests wait for the Keeper.
dialog.reviewtext: Describe the event and requested ruling
dialog.reviewlinked: Linked to your completed action. A review does not reroll or apply costs again.
dialog.reviewhelp: Describe the event for the Keeper to review.
inventory.usehelp: Spend a use or roll a usage die according to the item rules.
ai.title: AI assistant
ai.disabled: AI module is not loaded. The host can use start-web.cmd (web), start-ai.cmd (local), or start.ps1 -AI.
ai.scope: Consultation only; game state and configurations remain under normal game controls. KP forwards requests and reviews replies. Package action logs, clues and scene chat are not included automatically.
ai.name: Session name
ai.enabled: Allow AI calls (provider charges may apply)
ai.submitted: Request submitted. Its progress appears in the history below.
ai.offline: Connection or identity changed. Reopen the assistant.
ai.p2p: P2P currently supports generic host state and basic chat. Stumpsville scene actions are unavailable remotely. Internet players need the local networking client.
ai.p2perror: Network launch failed; check p2p.log and local configuration.
ai.pending: Outcome unknown. Check the receipt before retrying
map.legend: Select a room for its player characters, including the KP’s own character. NPCs and enemies are excluded.
ai.setupProvider: Module loaded. No provider profile is enabled. Open start-ai-manager.cmd, configure credentials and enable a profile, then reopen this panel.
ai.enableHint: Module loaded. Enable AI calls and save to enable this room. The model is called only when the KP dispatches a request.
ai.ready: AI calls are enabled for this room; each request still requires KP dispatch.
ai.web: Web players can submit personal consultations; the local KP dispatches requests and reviews responses.
map.revealHint: Choose recipients. Players see only the names of discovered characters at their current location, without stats.
ai.nativeScope: Consultation with semantic references. KP messages dispatch to the model; player messages submit requests. Configuration publishing is unavailable.
web.setupHint: Paste into the platform creation page. Valid for ten minutes and one use; keep it private.
web.expired: Setup string expired. Restart web sharing to obtain a new one.
web.claimed: Room claimed. Use the platform management page.
ai.noRoomData: Chat is enabled, but no room data can be sent; AI searches will return empty results.
ai.scopeHelp: NPCs require KP data, configurations require public data, and scene chat or package events require private data. Enable only the scopes you agree to send to this provider. Search matches display names, not NPC types; empty results do not prove absence.
ai.reloadGuide: AI is using an older query guide. Close the room launcher and start it again, then create a new conversation. Refreshing the page does not update the AI snapshot.
